title: 第9章 重逢第10章 交接
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
盛夏的雨来得又重又急，将醉春楼前面的土路打成泥地，楼里一片喧嚣，似有人在争执着什么。
这酒楼是顾三金的产业，平日里三教九流都要给些面子，今天却闯入七八个大汉，清一色的黑色短打，并列站在门前，堵住了进出的路。
"顾掌柜，你这醉春楼的买卖是越发红火了。"独眼李跷着腿坐在条案上，鞋底沾着的烂菜叶蹭脏了案板。
他身后两个混混正把花生壳往酒坛里扔，脆响混着黄酒汩汩声，听得顾三金青筋直跳。
“都是朋友们抬爱，李堂主，今天的事划下个道来吧。”顾三金强忍着怒火，这群混蛋，今天是发什么疯。
“朋友们抬爱?可顾掌柜怎的不拿俺们当朋友呢。”独眼李嗤笑一声，手中的小刀如蝴蝶般上下飞舞，猛的插进面前的木桌上。
不给顾三金插话的机会，独眼李自顾说道。
“俺黑刀帮来这立棍都六个月了，整个城南都知道交规费。”
“就你最不懂事，怎么，看不起俺们？”
独眼李从桌上拔出小刀，在顾三金的脸皮上比划着。
“不给面子又怎样？”
一道声音传来，独眼李不耐地皱了皱眉，往旁边吐了口唾沫，就要转头看看是哪个王八蛋活的不耐烦了。
不等他转过头来，便感觉脖子一凉。
“呃……呃……”
独眼李捂住脖子，缓缓倒下，死前仿佛看到一缕蓝色的气飘过，永远地失去意识。
蓝色灵气飘过，似一匹轻盈的丝绸，在空中钻出几蓬血雾，又飘回青年的手里，消失不见。
只见那青年身穿青袍，胸前绣着一只青鼎，温和地笑着。
“爹，我回来了。”
顾三金张大了嘴，眼神惊愕不已，随即红了眼眶。
“安儿，你是安儿？”

“是我，爹。”
顾安的眼睛也微微有些湿润，离家已八年，说不想是假的，他是胎穿，从小就被这一世的爹娘照顾，对他们很有感情。
“我儿长大了，都会杀人了，来，快让爹看看。”顾三金欣慰地看着顾安，大声夸奖道。
“？”
这不对吧？
顾安感觉记忆里那个慈祥的老爹的形象在崩塌。
“三儿，四儿，你们处理一下楼里，弄干净点。”说着，顾三金拉着顾安往外走，“你不知道，你走这几年，你娘一直惦记着你，走，咱回家。”
往旁边的巷子里走了几十步，就到了一座青石磊的四进大院。
过正门，垂花门，到了内院，顾三金大喊道：“夫人，夫人，你看是谁回来了。”
“谁啊，大晚上的，带到后院来？”
一穿着蓝色长裙的身影推门而出，却是顾母刘婉。
“安儿！！”
……
一柱香后，顾安坐在圆桌旁，桌上摆着各类佳肴。
玉色玛瑙盘中盛着整只炙烤羔羊，青瓷葵口碗内装着银鱼笋丝羹，冰鉴里铺着金齑玉脍……
“来，安儿，多吃点。”顾母又盛了一碗羹。
“够了够了，娘，吃不下了。”顾安忙接过来，顾母笑眯了眼，显然没听进去，顾父也是乐呵呵的，这桌菜是他主厨，都是顾安小时候爱吃的。
修仙者中有不少人辟谷，吃辟谷丹度日，认为五谷浊气不利于修炼，而辟谷可净化身心、调理脏腑、疏通经络，有益于修士炼气。
顾安也吃过两枚辟谷丹，没甚么滋味，不管是前世还是今生，顾安都馋这一口吃的，就更加不愿服这辟谷丹。
content_en:
The midsummer rain came hard and fast, turning the dirt road in front of Zuichun Tower into mud. There was a lot of noise in the building, as if someone was arguing about something.
This restaurant is Gu Sanjin's property. Normally, all three religions and nine schools would give some respect, but today, seven or eight big men broke in, all wearing black shorts, standing side by side in front of the door, blocking the way in and out.
"Shopkeeper Gu, your business in Zuichunlou is getting more and more prosperous." One-eyed Li sat on the counter with his legs crossed, and the rotten vegetable leaves on the soles of his shoes stained the chopping board.
Two gangsters behind him were throwing peanut shells into the wine jar. The crisp sound mixed with the gurgling sound of rice wine made Gu Sanjin's veins jump.
"It's all because of friends' love. Hall Master Li, let's put the matter behind today." Gu Sanjin suppressed his anger. These bastards, why are they crazy today?
"Friends love me? But why doesn't Shopkeeper Gu treat us as friends?" One-eyed Li sneered, the knife in his hand flew up and down like a butterfly, and he thrust it into the wooden table in front of him.
One-eyed Li Zigu said without giving Gu Sanjin a chance to interrupt.
"My Black Knife Gang has been here to set up sticks for six months, and everyone in the south of the city knows to pay the dues."
"You are the most ignorant. Why do you look down on us?"
One-eyed Li pulled out the knife from the table and drew it on Gu Sanjin's face.
"So what if I don't give you face?"
A voice came, and One-Eyed Li frowned impatiently, spat to the side, and turned around to see which bastard was getting impatient.
Before he could turn around, he felt a chill on his neck.
"Uh... uh..."
One-Eyed Li covered his neck and slowly fell down. Before he died, he seemed to see a wisp of blue air passing by and lost consciousness forever.
The blue aura floated past, like a piece of light silk, and several puffs of blood mist emerged in the air, then floated back to the young man's hand and disappeared.
I saw the young man wearing a green robe with a green tripod embroidered on his chest, smiling gently.
"Dad, I'm back."
Gu Sanjin opened his mouth wide, his eyes were filled with shock, and then his eyes turned red.
"An'er, are you An'er?"
"It's me, dad."
Gu An's eyes were also slightly moist. He had been away from home for eight years. He was lying if he said he didn't want to. He had a transcarnation and had been taken care of by his parents in this life since he was a child. He had great affection for them.
"My son will be able to kill people when he grows up. Come on, let dad see it." Gu Sanjin looked at Gu An with joy and praised loudly.
"?"
Isn't this right?
Gu An felt that the image of the kind father in his memory was crumbling.
"San'er, Si'er, please take care of the downstairs and make it clean." With that, Gu Sanjin pulled Gu An out, "You don't know, your mother has been thinking about you in the past few years since you left. Let's go home."
After walking dozens of steps into the alley next to it, we arrived at a four-entry courtyard with bluestones.
After passing the main gate and the Hanging Flower Gate, and arriving at the inner courtyard, Gu Sanjin shouted: "Madam, Madam, look who is back."
"Who brought it to the backyard at night?"
A figure wearing a blue dress pushed out the door, but it was Gu's mother Liu Wan.
"An'er!!"
…
After lighting a stick of incense, Gu An sat at a round table with various delicacies placed on it.
The jade agate plate holds a whole roasted lamb, the celadon sunflower mouth bowl holds shredded silverbait soup with bamboo shoots, and the ice bowl is covered with gold and jade dumplings...
"Come on, An'er, eat more." Mother Gu filled another bowl of soup.
"That's enough, Mom, I can't eat any more." Gu An hurriedly took it. Gu's mother smiled and narrowed her eyes, obviously not listening. Gu's father was also cheerful. He was the chef on this table, and they were all Gu An's favorites when he was a child.
Many immortal cultivators engage in fasting and eat fasting pills to live their lives. They believe that the turbid qi of grains is not conducive to cultivation, while fasting can purify the body and mind, regulate the internal organs, dredge the meridians, and is beneficial to monks in refining their qi.
Gu An has also eaten two Bigu Pills, and they are not very tasty. No matter in his previous life or in this life, Gu An is greedy for this food, and he is even more unwilling to take this Bigu Pill.
